title: Kusanagi Nene — Celebrate With Fireworks〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is it just me or are there way more people here than usual?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's probably because of Little Mermaid show was a big success!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My brothers even said that ticket sales for the park went up again a little after we finished performing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? That's great...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're apparently sending out notices and stuff for us too♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Notices?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ Like how today's show is gonna be an encore of the show we did at the beach!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially considering how well our show seemed to be trending online.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Some of these guests may very well be here today because of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it seems that your brothers made sure to catch this wave before it broke.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, our show succeeded and this is the result!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We can safely say that we are off to a great start as ambassadors!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I could not agree more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we've only taken out first steps, and we'll need to keep this up to establish ourselves as ambassadors.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's do this! Starting with today's show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay. How many times do I have to tell you to keep it down?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this crowd's huge.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not too long ago, I was so nervous about messing up in front of an audience like this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't wait to get on stage. I'm so excited.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Emu seems happy too.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I guess it's no wonder since she's been doing everything in her power to get more people the visit Phoenix Wonderland and our stage.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe this park will return to being as lively as it used to be.)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Everyone, it's almost showtime.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... Oh, Robo-Nene, are you fully charged?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Beep... 85% remaining.
No problems to report.
Plenty of juice, so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we're all set.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's showtime!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: What do I do?! Even if I did try to rescue them, I'll just end up getting caught too...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
I still have that weird potion!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So far so good.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All that's left is for me to transform into Robo-Nene...)

rows.Speaker: Child A
rows.Line: You can do it, Little Mermaid!

rows.Speaker: Child B
rows.Line:
Save them!
We believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That signal...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Go get 'em, Nene!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone!
I really appreciate your support...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hey, she thanked us!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like we're a part of the show now!

rows.Speaker: Child A
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: So many human children are cheering for me. I guess humans really aren't all bad, huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line:
I was really scared at first...
But you've given me the courage to drink this potion!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Here goes nothing...!

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wait... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: Wh-What just happened to me?!

rows.Speaker: Child B
rows.Line: Look, she turned into a robot!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: This is what happens after that emotional scene?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A job well done with our first encore performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
We got such a big round of applause too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You threw in a nice twist there too, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. It was a nice way to thank the crowd and bring them into the story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It was absolutely brilliant!
Well done, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It just crossed my mind in the heat of the moment...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I would never have been able to improvise or ad-lib like this before...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I learned how to thanks to them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm really learning and getting better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And if I can keep this up, maybe someday I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I'm here today because of my friends.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Which is why leaving them was so hard...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But I don't regret my decision.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I've been able to achieve my dreams and learn to love doing shows because they were there to support me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I still have no idea what I really want to do or what to do about it...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I want you to be the one to figure out what's truly best for you.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Luka even said so. I still have plenty of time to figure things out.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's curtain call time, Nene!
Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!
